title: Meet Bonaventure and discuss his life

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Well, what can I do for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, what can I do for you?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I keep it running if that’s what you mean. Fill the fridge, set out the chairs, keep the lights on, make sure no one floods the joint.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I keep it running if that’s what you mean. Fill the fridge, set out the chairs, keep the lights on, make sure no one floods the joint.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Oh, I am. I love commerce. Live and breathe it, gotta chase those Lims right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I am. I love commerce. Live and breathe it, gotta chase those Lims right?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I’m doing my best. Truth be told, I never thought I'd be here this long. It was supposed to be a temporary arrangement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m doing my best. Truth be told, I never thought I'd be here this long. It was supposed to be a temporary arrangement.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Thirty years next spring.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thirty years next spring.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I know. Every year I tell myself it will be the last. Every morning I say "just another day". I’ve said it 10957 times.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. Every year I tell myself it will be the last. Every morning I say "just another day". I’ve said it 10957 times.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Not what. Who.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not what. Who.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I'd have to disagree.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd have to disagree.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: No. I can see that. But Lims can't buy love. Remember that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. I can see that. But Lims can't buy love. Remember that.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Thirty years ago I fell in love with a man from across the sea. A merchant sailing in from Sang-Ha.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thirty years ago I fell in love with a man from across the sea. A merchant sailing in from Sang-Ha.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Two weeks we had. The two brightest weeks of my life. But then he had to make the return voyage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Two weeks we had. The two brightest weeks of my life. But then he had to make the return voyage.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: He had a tracker in his arm, said his bosses would set it off if he didn’t go back. But he swore he’d return. He'd buy a boat he'd been saving for, the Annabel Lee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He had a tracker in his arm, said his bosses would set it off if he didn’t go back. But he swore he’d return. He'd buy a boat he'd been saving for, the Annabel Lee.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: He said it would take him two years to make it there and back. Then we would leave to sail the world together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He said it would take him two years to make it there and back. Then we would leave to sail the world together.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Some days I hope so. Because then he might still be alive out there somewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some days I hope so. Because then he might still be alive out there somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Around the time he was supposed to return, there was a storm. One of the worst Nivalis has ever seen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Around the time he was supposed to return, there was a storm. One of the worst Nivalis has ever seen.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Do you know how to reach Sang-Ha? Even if I did find some relay, he might be anywhere by now. But there’s one thing I've been meaning to try...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know how to reach Sang-Ha? Even if I did find some relay, he might be anywhere by now. But there’s one thing I've been meaning to try...

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: If his ship went down in a storm, there might be a trace of it still. Under the waves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If his ship went down in a storm, there might be a trace of it still. Under the waves.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Yes. Somewhere in the ocean around the Rigs. That’s where the storm hit hardest. If I knew for certain he was never coming I might be able to leave.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. Somewhere in the ocean around the Rigs. That’s where the storm hit hardest. If I knew for certain he was never coming I might be able to leave.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Thank you. All I have to give is my business license, but you'd be welcome to that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. All I have to give is my business license, but you'd be welcome to that.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I'm long past luck, friend. But thank you all the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm long past luck, friend. But thank you all the same.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Not really. I'm just waiting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really. I'm just waiting.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: We met one night among the neon-shine of the Docks and I fell for him faster than an anchor thrown into the deep.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We met one night among the neon-shine of the Docks and I fell for him faster than an anchor thrown into the deep.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Doesn't make it less hurtful for those in the story.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't make it less hurtful for those in the story.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: So, I took on the license for this place. And I've been waiting ever since.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, I took on the license for this place. And I've been waiting ever since.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I told myself he’d know better than to sail into it. But…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I told myself he’d know better than to sail into it. But…

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: But I’ve never been able to look. Barely able to set foot on the Docks, to be honest. Reminds me of him too much.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I’ve never been able to look. Barely able to set foot on the Docks, to be honest. Reminds me of him too much.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you own this place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you own this place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you own this place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you own this place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don’t sound too enthusiastic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don’t sound too enthusiastic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don’t sound too enthusiastic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don’t sound too enthusiastic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn’t look like you’re catching very many.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn’t look like you’re catching very many.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn’t look like you’re catching very many.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn’t look like you’re catching very many.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long have you been here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long have you been here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long have you been here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long have you been here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That’s not exactly temporary...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s not exactly temporary...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That’s not exactly temporary...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That’s not exactly temporary...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you waiting for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you waiting for?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you waiting for?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you waiting for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No one's worth waiting that long for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No one's worth waiting that long for.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No one's worth waiting that long for.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No one's worth waiting that long for.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Someone special to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone special to you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Someone special to you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Someone special to you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time to hang around discussing romance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time to hang around discussing romance.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time to hang around discussing romance.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time to hang around discussing romance.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me what happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me what happened.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tell me what happened.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tell me what happened.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And then...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And then...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And then...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And then...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why couldn't he stay?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why couldn't he stay?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why couldn't he stay?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why couldn't he stay?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't it take forever to get to Sang-Ha?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't it take forever to get to Sang-Ha?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn't it take forever to get to Sang-Ha?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn't it take forever to get to Sang-Ha?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like he lied to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like he lied to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like he lied to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like he lied to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like something happened to him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like something happened to him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like something happened to him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like something happened to him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Couldn't you try to contact him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Couldn't you try to contact him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Couldn't you try to contact him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Couldn't you try to contact him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean a shipwreck?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean a shipwreck?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You mean a shipwreck?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You mean a shipwreck?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a boat. I'll go and look for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a boat. I'll go and look for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have a boat. I'll go and look for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have a boat. I'll go and look for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Afraid I can't help. But good luck to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Afraid I can't help. But good luck to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Afraid I can't help. But good luck to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Afraid I can't help. But good luck to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Leave it to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leave it to me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Leave it to me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Leave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sure you're enthusiastic about the business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure you're enthusiastic about the business?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You sure you're enthusiastic about the business?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You sure you're enthusiastic about the business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Supposed to be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Supposed to be?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Supposed to be?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you're still liking this place?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you're still liking this place?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like you're still liking this place?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like you're still liking this place?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Heard that kind of story a thousand times ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heard that kind of story a thousand times ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Heard that kind of story a thousand times ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Heard that kind of story a thousand times ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I really don't have time for this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I really don't have time for this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I really don't have time for this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I really don't have time for this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He still tried to get to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He still tried to get to you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He still tried to get to you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He still tried to get to you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Forget about him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Forget about him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Forget about him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Forget about him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not going so well at the moment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not going so well at the moment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not going so well at the moment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not going so well at the moment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wow.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wow.
